_comment: Camera and route definitions for the ShinKong B3 connecting lane. Stages are listed in driving order; each stage is a list of alternatives written CAMERA:ZONE (B0-B2 = Box-0..2, CL1/CL2 = Cross-Line-1/2, CL = merged cross-line message). Update this file, not the script, whenever a camera's boxes or lines are moved, redirected or merged.
config_history: 2026-10-19 ~16:30  vendor re-tuned C/D cross-lines (before that they missed often and stopped at 16:14-17:08)
2026-10-19 later   IP-CAM-F changed to Box-0, Box-1 (north branch), Cross-Line-1/2 (lane exit to HuoShih); old F Box-2 dropped
2026-10-21         cameras now send 1 message per line crossing and at most 1 message per second per occupied box (vendor alarm interval)
2026-10-21 ~17:45  IP-CAM-E cross-lines moved next to the connecting lane: E CL1 southbound (after B CL1), E CL2 northbound (after B B2); for older logs use --drop E:CL1 --drop E:CL2
2026-10-22 route order corrected from measured positions (section 11): E CL1 fires at the GuiLan exit, after B B2 and C/D/E B2, just before C/D CL1; E CL2 fires just before B B2

2026-10-22 ~21:00  F's and E's cross-lines deleted; C Box-1 and D Box-1 shrunk; A Cross-Line-1 moved about half a car length toward the lane (now just past A Cross-Line-2, both southbound). Older logs are analysed without the E/F lines unless they are added back to the stages
2026-10-23 analysis: chain_window_s 20 -> 30 (cars stop up to ~22 s between zones, e.g. 10/23 14:18 between C/D B2 and B B2)
